description: This file defines an Angular component named 'TreeNodePropertiesDataViewComponent' used to display properties of a tree node in a visual data view. It includes template logic for displaying a property key and value, with styling based on the value content.

classes.name: TreeNodePropertiesDataViewComponent
classes.description: An Angular component that renders a property key and value from a PropertiesTreeNode, applying conditional styling based on the property's value.

methods.name: valueClass
methods.description: Determines the CSS class to apply to the property value based on its content, differentiating null, boolean, number, or other types.
